attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Michigan state income tax. Flat 4.25% rate (MCL § 206.51, 2025) on AGI minus total personal exemptions. Exemption: $5,800/person × (taxpayers + dependents). The richer rules (itemization, retirement subtractions, age-67+ standard deduction, disabled-veteran exemption) are a follow-up; this implementation handles the simple W-2 case. Writes result.mi_taxable_income, result.mi_total_exemption, and result.mi_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.mi_state_tax = 0; set result.mi_taxable_income = 0; set result.mi_total_exemption = 0; add " Michigan Tax Calculation (Form MI-1040) - flat 4.25%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.mi_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.mi_taxable_income xdef 0 cvd /result.mi_total_exemption xdef " Michigan Tax Calculation (Form MI-1040) - flat 4.25%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (MI has no filing-status differences in rate/per-person exemption)

action_details.action_comment: MI exemptions = $5,800 x (taxpayers + dependents); tax = 4.25% x max(AGI - exemptions, 0)
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mi_total_exemption = (length of job.taxpayers + length of job.dependents) * mi_exemption_single; set result.mi_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - result.mi_total_exemption) and 0.0; set result.mi_state_tax = result.mi_taxable_income * mi_tax_rate; add " MI exemptions ($5,800 per person): $" + result.mi_total_exemption to job.audit_trail; add " MI state tax (4.25%): $" + result.mi_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: job.taxpayers length job.dependents length + mi_exemption_single fmul cvd /result.mi_total_exemption xdef result.agi result.mi_total_exemption f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mi_taxable_income xdef result.mi_taxable_income mi_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.mi_state_tax xdef " MI exemptions ($5,800 per person): $" result.mi_total_exemption strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " MI state tax (4.25%): $" result.mi_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.mi_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.mi_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.mi_taxable_income cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.mi_state_tax cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Michigan military retirement income exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. Per MCL § 206.30 (2025), 100% exclusion for military retirement pay + SBP. MSRRA / SCRA compliant.
